_doc: Rocket tiers (Mk I-IV): Lumi's ship, automation/ship_model.gd ([ship]; each Mk adds parts, ShipTiers.parts_for), bought in the workbench Rockets tab. Mk I comes with a level 5 base. countdown_s/sequence: shorter launch cinematic; flight_s: globe flight; recharge_s: energy cells refill after a launch before the next one; cargo_mult/cargo_period_s: Rocket Cargo pods (automation/cargo.gd); warp: instant hop (no countdown, a flash). [v6pace] hubs = how many hubs of a round planet this tier can keep restored, the start hub included (RocketTiers.hub_limit(): Mk I reaches 3, Mk II 5, Mk III all), so the rocket is upgraded along the planet's arc (owner note 64). Mk III no longer waits for the Rocket Cargo research.

tiers.name: Mk I Cradle
tiers.desc: A compact one-seat glider: pearl hull, swept wings, twin engines and lift fans for vertical take-off.

tiers.name: Mk II Glide
tiers.desc: Wing extensions steady the climb: shorter countdown, faster flight, cells refill twice as fast. Cargo pods carry 50% more.

tiers.name: Mk III Halo
tiers.desc: Bigger engines and a new canopy. Cells refill in a minute; cargo pods carry 2.5x, more often.

tiers.name: Mk IV Aurora Warp
tiers.desc: Landing gear, cargo pods and a warp core: instant hops with no recharge. Cargo pods carry 4x, every 30 s.
